subject: Post-demo: IAM & compliance follow-up — SSO/SCIM evidence and SOC 2 timeline
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Security Team <security@mediflow.com>, Joe Simmons <joe.simmons@mediflow.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-18T15:20:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: IAM & compliance follow-up — SSO/SCIM evidence and SOC 2 timeline

Hi Joe / Mediflow Security Team,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the detailed questions. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can keep momentum for the pilot: 

1) Recap of ask from the call
- You requested our SOC 2 status and any interim controls evidence.
- Confirm SAML 2.0 SSO support and provide IdP metadata for your engineers.
- Confirm SCIM provisioning endpoints & attributes.
- Screenshots / short video showing RBAC/admin controls for account and key management.
- Start of vendor questionnaire (we expect an XLSX).

2) What I can share immediately
- SAML 2.0 support: we can provide a metadata XML (attached: redwood_sso_metadata.xml).
- SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0 with token-based auth; sample endpoints and attribute map are below in this message.
- RBAC: we can capture admin console screenshots and a short 2–3 minute screen recording; will attach once produced.

3) SOC 2 / compliance timeline
- Current status: SOC 2 Type II engagement in progress, expected audit report delivery Q3 2026.
- Interim evidence: we can provide our security program overview and control mappings (attached: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf) and selected SOC-aligned artifacts for review under an NDA.

4) Next steps / ask from you
- Please upload the vendor security questionnaire you mentioned (we can target completion within 3 business days after receiving it).
- Share any required BAA language or data flow concerns specific to PHI.
- Let us know a 45-min window next week for a focused security deep dive (include your engineering folks).

SCIM sample endpoints (for your engineers)
- Base: https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/
- Provision: POST /Users, PATCH /Users/{id}
- Attributes: userName, externalId, name.familyName, name.givenName, emails[type=work].value, groups

Attachments: redwood_sso_metadata.xml (SAML metadata), Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf

Thanks — looping in Rishi and Grace for technical follow-through.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Post-demo: IAM & compliance follow-up — SSO/SCIM evidence and SOC 2 timeline

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the clear recap — that helps. Attached is our vendor security questionnaire for initial intake (Mediflow-Vendor-Sec-Questionnaire.xlsx). A few immediate clarifying items:

- Can you confirm whether Redwood holds any PHI or if all processing is on behalf of Mediflow?
- We need a current SOC 2 Type II report or, if not available, an auditor letter and evidence of control implementation.
- Please confirm if you support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SSO flows.
- For SCIM, we require deprovisioning within 60s of user disable in our IdP — do you have SLA/metrics for provisioning latency?

Also attaching a spreadsheet with a few additional questions we prefer answered by the engineering lead.

Attachments: Mediflow-Vendor-Sec-Questionnaire.xlsx

Regards,
Mediflow Security Team
security@mediflow.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Security Team <security@mediflow.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-20T08:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: IAM & compliance follow-up — SSO/SCIM evidence and SOC 2 timeline

Hi — quick answers and what we can supply immediately: 

1) PHI handling
- Redwood processes data strictly as a service provider; we do not persist PHI beyond configured retention windows and can support customer-controlled data retention policies. We are prepared to sign a BAA — looping in Vivek from Legal to start that conversation.

2) SOC 2
- SOC 2 Type II report: final audit expected Q3 2026. In the meantime we can provide:
  - Security program overview (attached: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf)
  - Selected control evidence (access-control lists, change-control checklists) under NDA or secure share.

3) SSO / SAML
- Support: SAML 2.0, SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows are supported.
- Attached: redwood_sso_metadata.xml (metadata includes assertion consumer service URL and required attributes).

4) SCIM provisioning
- Protocol: SCIM 2.0 (token bearer auth).
- Deprovisioning: typical deprovision propagation is under 30s in our standard configuration; we can supply SLA language for Dedicated customers.
- Endpoints and sample mapping (see previous message).

5) RBAC & admin controls
- We'll produce a short set of screenshots for the admin console showing role definitions (admin, billing_admin, support_readonly) and key rotation steps. ETA: 48 hours.

6) Questionnaire
- We received your XLSX and will start filling it. Expect a completed draft in 2–3 business days.

Attached: redwood_sso_metadata.xml, Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf

If you prefer, Rishi or Grace can join a technical session this week to go over SCIM attributes and SAML flows. Proposed 45-min windows: Thu 2026-03-21 14:00–14:45 PT or Fri 2026-03-22 09:00–09:45 PT.

Best,
Monica
